messages:
sam_cs: Quick renewal note for AtlasGrid 18-month term request, customer wants invoices in EUR for EU entity and USD for US entity. Also asks CFO to sign for EU entity. Looping Sales/Finance/Legal.

taylor_sales: Does price change for 18 months? They asked to keep same ARR but prepay for 9 months now and 9 months later.

sam_cs: Customer asks to keep equivalent ARR, with pro-rated invoicing: first invoice covers months 1-9 (prepay), second invoice for months 10-18 with invoice date later. PO# 90012 attached.

ana_finance: Finance: we can do split invoices by currency but need legal entity on each invoice and currency exchange note. We also need VAT ID for EU entity. Billing emails?

ana_finance: Also confirm payment terms: prepay for first invoice (due on receipt), Net30 for second.

mike_legal: Legal: if EU CFO signs for the EU entity, we need the contract to reference the EU legal entity and include signature block for both Redwood Inc. (US) and Redwood EU Ltd. (our EU subsidiary). I'll draft an amendment for entity split and payment schedule.

taylor_sales: Confirmed with customer: EU legal entity is AtlasGrid EU GmbH (VAT DE123456789). CFO (cfo@atlasgrid.eu) will sign EU block. US entity will sign via VP Ops later.

billing_bot: Billing: Created billing tickets: TCK-451 for EUR invoice, TCK-452 for USD invoice. Please attach signed doc when ready.

sam_cs: Mike, can you include clause: "Invoices for AtlasGrid EU GmbH will be issued in EUR to the EU entity and are subject to VAT as applicable"?

mike_legal: Adding that line plus payment schedule table. Draft uploaded to DocuSign envelope AG-2026-18.

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign: Envelope AG-2026-18 created by mike_legal. Status: sent.

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign: Envelope AG-2026-18 signed by cfo@atlasgrid.eu at 2026-04-02T11:05:03Z. Status: partial.

taylor_sales: Noted. I'll follow up with US sponsor to get the VP Ops signature.

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign: Envelope AG-2026-18 signed by vops@atlasgrid.com at 2026-04-03T16:48:12Z. Status: completed.

sam_cs: Got signed PDF. Uploading to contract. Finance - please proceed with EUR invoice INV-2026-AG-EUR-01 (due on receipt) and USD invoice INV-2026-AG-USD-01 (Net30).

ana_finance: Received signed doc and VAT ID. Creating EUR invoice with VAT line and USD invoice referencing PO#90012. Scheduling sends per plan.

mike_legal: Contract records updated with dual-entity signature blocks. No further redlines.

sam_cs: Closing loop: 18-month term executed with dual-entity signers, split-currency invoicing and scheduled payment plan. Actions: 1) Attach signed PDF to SFDC. 2) Finance to send invoices. 3) Update billing contacts.

sam_cs: Thanks team :white_check_mark:
